comments.author: @Top10Documentary999
comments.text: What an amazing documentary! 🇹🇱👏 Timor-Leste is such a fascinating country, with a rich history, unique culture, and so many hidden stories waiting to be discovered. It’s wonderful to see this young nation through the eyes of a travel documentary. The scenery, traditions, and everyday life make this journey truly eye-opening. Keep up the fantastic work! 🌍❤

comments.author: @GlobalLifeInsights
comments.text: Knowing what happened at Santa Cruz in '91 and seeing where the country is today—joining ASEAN in late 2025—proves that the human spirit here is stronger than any resource curse. Absolute respect to Asia's youngest nation!

replies.author: @Globallife.documentary
replies.text: It is truly moving to see how the resilience of the Timorese people has carried them through such a turbulent history toward a future of regional integration.

comments.author: @Reallifeinsights.tv26
comments.text: They deserve to receive recognition from the world.

replies.author: @Globallife.documentary
replies.text: You said it perfectly! Having endured generations of colonization, brutal occupation, and having to rebuild their entire homeland from ashes in 2002, the resilience and quiet dignity of the Timorese people truly deserve worldwide recognition.

comments.text: They went through so much sacrifice to gain their independence ,I was there January 2003 and the country and it's borders were guarded by UN peacekeepers from Japan,Australia and Portugal ,to keep the Indonesian soldiers out ,after they came in to stop timor leste breaking away from Indonesia ,I saw a burnt church where over 120 women and children sheltering from the attempted genocide the Indonesian soldiers we're carrying out,we're barricaded in and burnt to death ,then I witnessed young boys with limbs cut off by the Indonesian soldiers ,luckily before they could eradicate the population and take the country back under Indonesia ,UN peacekeepers were sent in to protect and over see the transition period to independence ,the Timorese people went through so much to achieve there break away from Indonesia .sadly Indonesia is crushing and murdering  the indigenous people of west Papua now to hang onto to the mineral rich half of the island that really should be part of Papua new Guinea but is totally ignored by world focus .
